date.as_written: khyāte nāgakṛśānuvāraramite nepālaśāke śubhe taiṣemāsi(!) ca śuklapakṣakasite nūnaṃ hi rohiṇyutrau | dvādaśyāṃ gurūvāsare hariharo yoge sukarmmā ... || samvat 838 pauṣamāse śuklapakṣa ekādaśī pradvā(!) dvādaśyā(!) tathau(!) rohini(!)nakṣatre sukarmmayoge vṛhaspativāsare yathā karṇṇamudbhuta(!)ke makararāśigate savitari, vṛṣarāsi(!)gate, vṛṣarāṣi(!)gate candramasi

notes: No scribe, patron, or reigning king is named in the colophon. The chronogram nāga-kṛśānu-vāra represents 838 in the Nepāla era (NS 838).
